statement: For IVERI v0.91 at seq_len=64 (batch=8), disabling gradient checkpointing increases training throughput by 31.6% (154→203 tok/s). Backward pass dominates at 1762ms vs forward 759ms. VRAM remains within 4GB budget (peak 825MB).
evidence_completeness: COMPLETE for seq_len=64. Requires replication at seq_len=512+ to generalize.
